/* rt_c_fcsr.c - Round-trip fixture: fcsr (frm + sticky fflags) across the
 * handoff (L20).
 *
 * Phase 1 (QEMU1): set fcsr = 0x21 (frm=RTZ(1)<<5 | fflags=NX) right
 *   before the enter marker; the plugin drains it into
 *   hybrid_state_v1.fcsr (offset 5456, locked by state_abi_check.h).
 * Phase 2 (vsim): ResumeDriver must restore fcsr before the ROI runs.
 *   The in-ROI self-check reads it back; on mismatch the fixture exits 1
 *   immediately, so the vsim leg returns 1 instead of 200 and the harness
 *   fails loudly. On success it writes the distinct sentinel 0x45
 *   (frm=RDN(2)<<5 | fflags=NX|UF) for StateDrain to capture at the exit
 *   marker -- the drained file's fcsr field must read 0x45
 *   (tests/hybrid/e2e_fcsr_roundtrip.sh asserts both file values).
 *
 * crt0.S sets mstatus.FS=Initial, so fcsr is writable in M-mode on both
 * engines. The insns after the exit marker (main's epilogue) touch no FP
 * state, so the drain's 0-3 insn halt slack cannot disturb the sentinel.
 */
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "runtime/rt_c_helpers.h"

int main(void)
{
  /* Phase 1 (QEMU1): non-default rounding mode + a sticky flag. */
  unsigned long set = 0x21; /* frm=RTZ | fflags=NX */
  asm volatile("csrw fcsr, %0" ::"r"(set));

  enter_vsim();

  /* Phase 2 (vsim): the restored fcsr must be intact. */
  unsigned long got;
  asm volatile("csrr %0, fcsr" : "=r"(got));
  if (got != 0x21)
    exit(1);

  /* Leave a distinct value for the exit drain to capture. */
  unsigned long sentinel = 0x45; /* frm=RDN | fflags=NX|UF */
  asm volatile("csrw fcsr, %0" ::"r"(sentinel));

  exit_vsim();

  return 0;
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# L20: fcsr (frm + sticky fflags) round-trips QEMU1 -> vsim -> drain.
#
# rt_c_fcsr sets fcsr=0x21 (frm=RTZ | NX) before the enter marker; the
# plugin must drain it (state file offset 5456, locked by
# state_abi_check.h). The vsim leg's in-ROI self-check exits 1 if
# ResumeDriver did not restore the value, then writes the sentinel 0x45
# (frm=RDN | NX|UF) that StateDrain must capture at the exit marker.
#
# Manual TDD smoke; not auto-wired into scripts/run_e2e.sh (the fixture
# itself runs there via the normal marker/pc suite).

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/paths.sh"
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:-rt_c_fcsr}"
TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-120}"

hybrid_resolve_paths

SHARED_SIZE=$((128 * 1024 * 1024))
SHARED_MEM=$(mktemp -p /dev/shm vsim-fcsr-shared.XXXXXX)
STATE_QEMU=$(mktemp)
STATE_VSIM=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$SHARED_MEM" "$STATE_QEMU" "$STATE_VSIM"' EXIT
truncate -s "$SHARED_SIZE" "$SHARED_MEM"

read_u64_le() { od -A n -j "$1" -N 8 -t u8 "$2" | tr -d ' \n'; }
FCSR_OFF=5456  # locked by include/hybrid/state_abi_check.h (ceiling 128)

set +e
"$VSIM_QEMU" \
  -object "memory-backend-file,id=mem,share=on,mem-path=$SHARED_MEM,size=$SHARED_SIZE" \
  -machine andes_ae350,memory-backend=mem \
  -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512 \
  -nographic \
  -bios "$VSIM_ELF" \
  -plugin "$VSIM_PLUGIN,outfile=$STATE_QEMU" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
QEMU1_RC=$?
set -e
[ "$QEMU1_RC" -eq 200 ] || fail "QEMU 1 expected exit 200 on marker drain, got $QEMU1_RC"
[ -s "$STATE_QEMU" ]    || fail "QEMU 1 produced no state"

Q_FCSR=$(read_u64_le "$FCSR_OFF" "$STATE_QEMU")
[ "$Q_FCSR" -eq 33 ] \
  || fail "QEMU 1 drained fcsr=$Q_FCSR, want 33 (0x21: frm=RTZ | NX) -- plugin not draining fcsr?"
ok "QEMU 1 drained fcsr=0x21"

set +e
timeout "$TIMEOUT" "$VSIM_BIN" "$VSIM_ELF" \
  --resume-from-qemu "$STATE_QEMU" \
  --handoff-out "$STATE_VSIM" \
  --shared-mem-path "$SHARED_MEM" \
  --shared-mem-size "$SHARED_SIZE" \
  --shared-mem-base 0x00000000 </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
VSIM_RC=$?
set -e
[ "$VSIM_RC" -ne 1 ] \
  || fail "vsim leg exited 1: the fixture's in-ROI self-check saw fcsr != 0x21 (ResumeDriver not restoring fcsr?)"
[ "$VSIM_RC" -eq 200 ] || fail "vsim expected exit 200 (marker drain), got $VSIM_RC"
[ -s "$STATE_VSIM" ]   || fail "vsim produced no state"
ok "vsim in-ROI self-check passed (fcsr restored)"

V_FCSR=$(read_u64_le "$FCSR_OFF" "$STATE_VSIM")
[ "$V_FCSR" -eq 69 ] \
  || fail "vsim drained fcsr=$V_FCSR, want 69 (0x45: frm=RDN | NX|UF) -- StateDrain not reading fcsr back?"
ok "vsim drain captured the in-ROI fcsr sentinel 0x45"

echo "PASS e2e_fcsr_roundtrip"

37	 * in vector registers across the boundary can be hoisted before enter_vsim
38	 * or sunk after exit_vsim, charging its cycles to the wrong phase. (Tested
39	 * on the Andes GCC at -O2/-O3: an out-of-line marker does NOT help -- a
40	 * call only forces a register spill, not the position of the compute that
41	 * consumes the value.)
42	 *
43	 * To keep a kernel inside the measured window, anchor it through memory:
44	 *   - read its inputs from memory and write its outputs to memory INSIDE
45	 *     the span (the load cannot move before enter, the store cannot move
46	 *     after exit, and the compute is data-chained between them), or
47	 *   - put the kernel in its own __attribute__((noinline)) function called
48	 *     between the markers.
49	 * Both keep every kernel op in the ROI with zero annotation and zero
50	 * overhead. Carrying live vector values in registers across the boundary is
51	 * fine for CORRECTNESS (all regs round-trip) -- rt_c_v_regs.c does exactly

53	 * boundary) as the V-regfile TRANSPORT test -- but it is not safe for cycle
54	 * attribution. */
